Description: Lady Claricia Ruffo di Calabria is the eldest daughter of Count Pietro II, raised within the soaring clifftop citadel of Catanzaro overlooking the Ionian Sea. At twelve years of age, Claricia exhibits extraordinary composure, intellectual maturity, and acute perception, frequently observing judicial hearings and estate management beside her mother. Nurtured in statecraft and noble fortitude, Claricia views the turbulent Mediterranean world with steady calm. Combining southern aristocratic beauty with formidable intellectual composure, young Claricia grows in stature. Her quiet strength, analytical mind, and aristocratic grace make Claricia a beacon of promise for the future of Calabria. Motivations: Master administrative statecraft and diplomatic history to assist her noble parents.
Uphold the honor of the House of Ruffo and prove her capacity to guide dynastic destinies.
Values: Iron fortitude, intellectual mastery, and unshakeable inner resilience in the face of peril.
Noble responsibility, moral honor, and conscientious justice toward all feudal dependents.
Fears: Hostile artillery bombarding the mountain citadel and destroying ancestral treasures.
Becoming a helpless pawn in dynastic bargaining without agency over her own future.
